title: 第19章 发现气运之子家族第20章 先让气运之子玩几天
slug: 我都无敌了要你这系统有何用
content_zh:
青墨从房间里出来，身后跟着的柳雨柔面红耳赤。
“不知公子叫小女子来有何事？”
“你们秋月宫有两样东西，是我需要的，所以我才把你这个宫主叫来！”
秋月内心狂震，自己的残破神器影响不了眼前这个人的思想，他居然一语道破自己的真实身份。
“你不用脑补了，你身上那件残破神器确实能影响很多人的思想，哪怕在你原来的世界中都是不可多得的宝物，但是对本公子没用。
本公子要你们秋月宫里的阴魄草和元灵花！”
秋月感觉自己如赤身裸体一般，在眼前这个男人面前没有任何秘密可言。
“公子说的这两样东西，我秋月宫确实有，我想以公子这样修为通天之人，应该不会放下身段强抢吧？”
秋月知道眼前的人糊弄不了，想试试能不能换一些好处。
“嘴皮子有点东西！
本公子之前确实有这个想法，既然你都这样说了，想要什么？”
“不知，能不能请公子帮小女子解了体内剧毒？”
“可以”
青墨神念一扫，秋月体内的剧毒瞬间被泯灭。
“感谢公子，为我清除体内剧毒！”
“把本公子需要的东西送来就行了。”
“这个自然，我马上回秋月宫取来送给公子。”
青墨和柳雨柔起身前往西海，让秋月把东西准备好后，来西海找他们。
“主人，西海确实比南疆富饶多了！”
“还行吧。”

经过了一个月，青墨他们慢慢悠悠的来到了西海，几乎是一路走一路玩过来的。
西海上遍布着众多岛屿，一些家族和宗门都建立在岛屿之上。
“这里倒是个度假的好地方，咱们玩一段时间再去断念宫。”
“好的，主人。”
穿着花衬衫沙滩裤，带着个墨镜的青墨在沙滩上享受日光浴，海风拂过隐约能看到衬衫下的六块腹肌，旁边的柳雨柔一身黑色比基尼更显诱惑。
两人一身现代装扮，大白还趴在青墨肚皮上，耷拉着舌头呼呼大睡，时不时还打呼噜！
“喂，你们是谁？谁让你们来这的？”
一声不和谐的声音响起，把在午休的青墨等人吵醒，青墨把墨镜取下，斜眼看着吵醒自己的人。
“少爷，您看！”
“这女子，本少爷要了！
小子，谁允许你们到我孙家采矿禁地的？”
“宿主，这个孙家少爷有点意思啊！
居然和气运之子有些关联！”
青墨看着眼前这些人，尤其是孙家少爷，看来这个时代的气运之子在孙家。
“是啊！
看来气运之子在孙家，不知道我把他宰了会不会影响到气运之子的成长？”
青墨发现孙家少爷身上带着淡淡的气运，一般不是位高权重身居高位的人身上会有气运，那就是和气运之子有关联，要么是垫脚石要么是小弟，看这样子是垫脚石没错了。
孙家少爷眼神一直在柳雨柔的身上瞄来瞄去，没有丝毫掩饰。
content_en:
Qing Mo came out of the room, followed by Liu Yurou with a red face.
"I wonder why the young master called the little girl here?"
"There are two things in your Qiuyue Palace that I need, so I called you, the palace owner!"
Qiuyue was shocked in her heart. Her broken artifact could not affect the thoughts of the man in front of her, but he actually revealed her true identity in one sentence.
"You don't have to think about it. The broken artifact on your body can indeed affect the minds of many people. Even if it is a rare treasure in your original world, it is of no use to me.
I want the Yin Soul Grass and Yuanling Flower from your Qiuyue Palace! "
Qiuyue felt like she was naked, with no secrets left in front of the man in front of her.
"I do have the two things the Young Master mentioned in Qiuyue Palace. I think a person with such a cultivation level as the Young Master will not put down his body to rob them, right?"
Qiuyue knew that the person in front of her couldn't be fooled, so she wanted to try to see if she could get some benefits in exchange.
"There's something about your words!
I did have this idea before. Now that you have said so, what do you want? "
"I wonder, can you please help the young master remove the poison from the little girl's body?"
"Okay"
With a sweep of Qingmo's divine thought, the poison in Qiuyue's body was instantly wiped out.
"Thank you, Master, for removing the poison from my body!"
"Just bring me what I need."
"Of course, I will go back to Qiuyue Palace immediately to get it and give it to the young master."
Qing Mo and Liu Yurou got up and headed to Xihai, asking Qiuyue to prepare things before coming to Xihai to find them.
"Master, the Western Sea is indeed much richer than Southern Xinjiang!"
"It's okay."
After a month, Qing Mo and the others slowly came to Xihai, almost walking and playing all the way.
There are many islands scattered across the Western Sea, and some families and sects are established on the islands.
"This is a good place for a vacation. Let's play for a while and then go to the Suan Nian Palace."
"Okay, Master."
Wearing a floral shirt and beach pants, Qing Mo was sunbathing on the beach with sunglasses. The sea breeze blew through and you could vaguely see her six-pack abs under the shirt. Next to her, Liu Yurou was wearing a black bikini, which was even more tempting.
The two of them were dressed in modern clothes. Dabai was still lying on Qingmo's belly, sleeping soundly with his tongue hanging out, and snoring from time to time!
"Hey, who are you? Who asked you to come here?"
A discordant sound rang out, waking up Qing Mo and others who were taking a lunch break. Qing Mo took off his sunglasses and squinted at the person who woke him up.
"Master, look!"
“This young master wants this woman!
Boy, who allowed you to mine in the restricted area of my Sun family? "
"Host, this young master of the Sun family is quite interesting!
It actually has something to do with the Son of Destiny! "
Qing Mo looked at the people in front of him, especially the young master of the Sun family. It seemed that the lucky son of this era was in the Sun family.
"Yeah!
It seems that the Son of Luck is in the Sun family. I wonder if killing him will affect the growth of the Son of Luck? "
Qing Mo discovered that the young master of the Sun family had a touch of luck. Generally, it was not a person with high authority and a high position who would have luck, but someone who was related to the son of luck, either a stepping stone or a younger brother. It looked like it was a stepping stone.
The young master of the Sun family kept glancing at Liu Yurou's body without any cover-up.
